**Residue computation.** Since $1+z^2 = (z-i)(z+i)$:

$$\operatorname{Res}_{z=i} f(z) = \lim_{z \to i} (z-i)\,\frac{\sqrt{1-z^2}}{(z-i)(z+i)} = \frac{\sqrt{1 - i^2}}{2i} = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2i}.$$

$$\sqrt{1-z^2}\Big|_{z=i} = \sqrt{1+1} = \sqrt{2} \quad (\text{positive real}).$$

**Applying the residue theorem:**

$$\oint_C \frac{\sqrt{1-z^2}}{1+z^2}\,dz = 2\pi i \cdot \operatorname{Res}_{z=i} f(z) = 2\pi i \cdot \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2i} = \pi\sqrt{2}.$$
